stories.headline: College football's playoff grows to 24 teams from 2027
stories.summary: The College Football Playoff will grow from 12 teams to 24 from the 2027 season, and will keep that size through 2031. Each champion of the four power conferences, the ACC, the Big Ten, the Big 12 and the SEC, is guaranteed a place, and all four have agreed to stop holding their own championship games. Another 19 places go to the remaining highest-ranked teams.

stories.headline: China extends its suspension of export restrictions
stories.summary: China's commerce ministry has extended its suspension of export restrictions on certain rare earths, industrial diamonds and lithium battery technology. The suspension now runs to January 10, 2027. Trade negotiations with the United States are continuing.

stories.headline: Oxford museum returns Naga remains to a Nagaland delegation
stories.summary: The Pitt Rivers Museum in Oxford has returned the remains of 39 Naga people to a delegation from Nagaland, India. They were collected during the British Raj. The return follows six years of discussions over repatriation.

stories.headline: A tiny orange fish is new to science in the Amazon
stories.summary: A tiny fish with brilliant orange markings has been described as a new species in the Brazilian Amazon. Named Laimosemion laranja, it belongs to the killifish group and measures less than three centimetres in standard length. Scientists know it from only three small forest pools near Laranjal do Jari, and believe it already meets the criteria for Endangered status.
